feature_name: Regional endpoints for Sensitive Data Protection
summary: Regional endpoints for Sensitive Data Protection keep data at rest, in use, and in transit within a specified region.
extended_definition: Regional endpoints for Sensitive Data Protection keep data at rest, in use, and in transit within a specified region.

supporting_pages.title: "Global and regional endpoints for Sensitive Data Protection \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Choose between the global and regional endpoints Consider the following when choosing between global and regional endpoints: If your organization is required to keep data at rest, in use, and in transit within a specific region, then you must use regional endpoints.
Regional endpoints guarantee data residency by ensuring that your data at rest, in use, and in transit isn't moved out of the location specified by the endpoint.
Regional API endpoints Regional endpoints (REP) let you keep in-transit data within a specific region.
